# @vllnt/convex-buckets

> Ephemeral groups of opaque subject refs as a Convex component

`@vllnt/convex-buckets` is a publishable Convex component. It targets `convex@^1.45.0`.
It stores two sandboxed tables — `buckets` (`bucketRef`, `status` open/locked/closed, `capacity`,
`memberCount`, timestamps) and `members` (`bucketRef`, `subjectRef`, `joinedAt`). `open` creates a
group; `join` / `leave` mutate membership; `lock` stops joins; `close` is terminal. Capacity is
OCC-safe because `join` patches `memberCount` on the bucket row. `listMembers` is bounded (default
100, max 500). `eraseBucket` / `eraseSubject` delete in bounded batches and reschedule. The host
owns auth and the meaning of the group. Distinct from `@vllnt/convex-memberships` (standing
org/roles) and `@convex-dev/presence` (liveness).
